briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate frontier model race with multi-agent scaling breakthroughs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies as frontier labs release advanced multi-agent systems amid record funding. Regulatory pressure mounts while compute shortages persist globally.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with native agent orchestration; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; xAI deploys Grok-3 on expanded Memphis cluster; DeepSeek-V3 open weights trigger rapid adoption.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST releases new red-teaming guidelines for multi-agent deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins volume production of 2nm AI chips; Microsoft and Google announce joint $40B data center expansion across three continents.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a collaborative lab alliance or a single-nation sovereign effort?
